root_cause: During integration of BFF-DEAD-ADMISSION-PIPELINE-REMOVAL-001, PR #6021 was approved at exact head 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d on replacement branch task/BFF-DEAD-ADMISSION-PIPELINE-REMOVAL-001-v2 while the original branch also existed on origin. Base auto_integrator.py::fetch_refs fetched only candidate.branch and did not fetch the replacement branch or exact head commit. When run_rebase_smoke verified exact head ancestry, git failed with 'fatal: invalid reference: 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d' (event 26329), stranding PR #6021 in smoke-failed.
resolution: Implemented resolve_authoritative_head_branch to select the authoritative live or bound head branch (from head_branch, review_binding, or delivery_binding) for required fetching (check=True) and rebase target. Secondary and default branches are fetched optionally with check=False, preventing absent obsolete refs from aborting integration. Added direct fetch of exact_head commit. Preserved exact-head failure behavior (CommandFailure on invalid or unreachable exact head SHA; exact_head_missing when empty).
code_change: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py: implemented resolve_authoritative_head_branch; updated fetch_refs to fetch authoritative branch as required, optional branches as check=False, and exact_head commit directly; updated run_rebase_smoke target_branch; updated integrate_candidate head_branch argument.

verification.reproduction_and_control: Fresh-repository control with existing original branch and replacement-only commit reproduced 'fatal: invalid reference: 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d' on base and yielded clean_exact_head with fix. Additional regression scenario verified: absent obsolete original branch with existing replacement branch raises CommandFailure (128) fatal: could not find remote ref on base, but cleanly succeeds with check=False optional fetching. Negative tests confirmed empty exact head yields exact_head_missing and invalid exact head raises CommandFailure.
verification.head_ancestry_check: git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/dev 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d verified exit 0 once fetched.
verification.fetch_refs_verification: Verified authoritative live/bound branch is selected for required fetching, exact head commit is fetched directly, absent obsolete branches do not fail with check=False, and exact head failure behavior is preserved on missing or invalid commit references.
